prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1373; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the full liability limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with the declarations page for each policy. We also ask that you confirm in writing that your insured has been notified of this claim.

Please preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and telematics, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Any alteration, repair, or disposal of the vehicles involved should be avoided until both sides have had the opportunity to inspect them.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
